meta.title: Connection & security headers check - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Check a site's response status and security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, Server). Browsers cannot read TLS certificates - use the padlock in the address bar for certificate details.
desc: Check a site's response status and security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, Server). Browsers cannot read TLS certificates - use the padlock in the address bar for certificate details.
ui.2: Enter a domain and click Check
ui.102: Enter a domain or URL, e.g. example.com
securityNote: Browsers cannot read TLS certificate details; use the padlock in the address bar. This tool only shows response headers that the target site exposes to cross-origin requests.
corsHint: Note: the target site does not allow cross-origin access, so the browser refuses to expose its response headers. This is the same-origin policy, not a site failure.
